spans.s:
स्फट् स्फट् (thought to be for an original
स्पर्त्; cf. Germ. spalten; Eng. split),
cl. 1. P. स्फटति, &c., to burst, expand, &c. (= rt.
स्फुट्, q. v.): Caus. or cl. 10. P. स्फाटयति, &c.,
to split open, cleave; to kill (= rt. स्फिट्).

स्फट, अस्, आ, m. f. a snake's expanded hood;
(ई), f. alum, (see स्फटिकारि below.)

स्फटिक, अस्, m. crystal, quartz; (आ), f. sulphate
of alumina or alum.
—स्फटिक-प्रभ, अस्, आ, अम्,
glittering like crystal, crystalline, transparent.
—स्फ-
टिक-मणि-गृह, अम्, n. a house of crystalline gems,
crystal-abode.
—स्फटिक-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made
or consisting of crystal, crystalline.
—स्फटिक-
स्कम्भ, अस्, m. a crystal pillar.
—स्फटिक-हर्-
म्य, अम्, n. a crystal palace.
—स्फटिकाचल (˚क-
अच्˚), अस्, m. ‘crystal-mountain,’ mount Meru.
—स्फटिकात्मन् (˚क-आत्˚), आ, m. crystal.
—स्फ-
टिकाद्रि (˚क-अद्˚), इस्, m. ‘crystal-mountain,’ the
mountain Kailāsa.
—स्फटिकाद्रि-भिद, अस्, m.
‘penetrating Kailāsa,’ camphor.
—स्फटिकाभ्र (˚क-
अभ्˚), अस्, m. ‘crystal-cloud,’ camphor.
—स्फटि-
काश्मन् (˚क-अश्˚), आ, m. ‘crystal-stone,’ crystal.

स्फाटिक, अस्, ई, अम्, made of crystal, crystalline;
(अम्), n. crystal.
—स्फाटिकोपल (˚क-उप्˚), अम्, n.
‘crystal-stone,’ crystal.
स्फाटीक, अम्, n. crystal, quartz.

स्फटिकारि, इस्, or स्फटिकारिका or स्फटिकारी,
f. sulphate of alumina or alum (commonly corrupted
into फट्-करी, फट्-कारी, फट्-किरि).
स्फटिकी, f. (according to some) alum.

स्फाटक, अस्, m. a drop of water; (अम्), n.
crystal.
स्फाटक स्फाटक, स्फाटिक. See above.

स्फाटित, अस्, आ, अम्, split open, expanded, made
to gape, cleft.

स्फण्ट् स्फण्ट्, cl. 1. P. स्फण्टति, &c., to
burst, open, expand, &c. (= rt. स्फुट्,
q. v.), cl. 10. P. स्फण्टयति, to jest or joke with
(= rt. स्फण्ड्).

स्फण्ड् स्फण्ड्, cl. 1. P. स्फण्डति, &c.,
cl. 10. P. स्फण्डयति, to jest or joke
with, to laugh at.

स्फर् स्फर् = rt. स्फुर्, and serving as
the form of its Caus. स्फारयति, &c.,
see स्फुर्, वि-स्फुर्.

स्फरण, अम्, n. trembling, quivering, throbbing,
vibration.

स्फारण, अम्, n. the act of throbbing, shaking,
trembling; causing to throb or vibrate (fr. the Caus.).

1. स्फार, अस्, m. (for 2. see p. 1152), throbbing,
quivering, vibration; twanging (of a bow-string; cf.
वि-स्फार).
2. स्फार, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.
II. 13

.
fr. rt. स्फाय् above; perhaps also connected with rt.
स्फर् and 1. स्फार), swelling, increase, enlargement
(= वृद्धि); a bubble (in gold &c.); a protuber-
ance [cf. Gr. σφαῖρα] (अस्, आ, अम्), large, increased,
expanded, spreading, great; abundant; loud; (अम्),
n. much, abundance.
—स्फारी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भ-
वति, &c., to become large or swollen, swell out,
expand, spread out; to become manifest.

स्फार स्फार, स्फारण. See p. 1151,
col. 3, and above.

2. स्फारित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 2. स्फार above; but
perhaps also connected with rt. स्फर्), swollen out,
spread out, extended, large.

स्फल् स्फल्, cl. 1. P. स्फलति, पस्फाल,
स्फलितुम्, to tremble, quiver, throb,
palpitate, beat (= rt. स्फुल्, q. v.): Caus. स्फाल-
यति, -यितुम्, to cause to tremble or shake, &c.;
[cf. Gr. σφάλλ-ω, σφάλ-μα, ἀ-σφαλ-ής, σφαλ-ερός;
Lat. fall-o, fal-sus, falla, fallax, fallac-ia; Old
Germ. fallan; Lith. pula, pulti, ‘to fall.’]

स्फाल, अस्, m. throbbing, quivering, palpitation,
beat, trembling, shaking.
स्फाल स्फाल, स्फालन. See p. 1151.

स्फालन, अम्, n. the act of palpitating, shaking,
quivering; causing to shake about or move; rubbing,
friction; stroking or patting (a horse &c.).

स्फाय् स्फाय् (thought by some to be
derived from a Pass. of a lost rt. स्पन्,
प् becoming फ् through the influence of initial स्;
but apparently connected in some senses with rts.
स्फर्, स्फुर्), cl. 1. A. स्फायते, पस्फाये, स्फा-
यितुम्, to grow large or fat, become bulky, swell,
expand, increase: Caus. स्फावयति (perhaps ori-
ginally स्फापयति), -यितुम्, Aor. अपिस्फवत्
(Pāṇ.

स्फात, अस्, आ, अम्, grown big, swollen, enlarged,
increased.

स्फाति, इस्, f. swelling, intumescence, increase,
growth.

स्फावयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, augmenting, increasing,
enlarging.
